claims.statement: Model: torchvision ResNet-18 with ImageNet weights (IMAGENET1K_V1), 1,000 classes; input 224x224x3 = 150,528 numbers.
First layer: 64 learned 7x7 filters; maps go from 64 x 112x112 (conv1) to 512 x 7x7 (layer4).
Hero photo (CC0): golden retriever 73.5%, Great Pyrenees 21.9%.
claims.caveat: One photo; probabilities are the model's, not accuracy.

claims.statement: Other photos: goldfish 98.4%; a tabby called Egyptian cat 35.5%; a cat called mousetrap 49.1% (wrong).
claims.caveat: Three photos; not an accuracy estimate.

claims.statement: Targeted PGD (L-inf, 2/255, 40 steps) to 'goldfish': saved 8-bit image changes each value by at most 2/255 (85.1% of values changed, PSNR 44.4 dB); the model then says goldfish with more than 99.99%.
claims.caveat: White-box (attacker knows the weights), one model, one photo, digital only.
